quote: The smileys are mixed in for sure and the fakes are really sad and bad… I am 92% of the way with a tracker for the actuals

claim: A community member said only three of the numbered /100 smileys are accounted for so far; anything beyond that is speculation.
quote: There are 3 numbers of the 100 accounted for as of now. Anything else is speculation

claim: A community member reported four numbered smileys listed on eBay that morning with consecutive numbers; two listings were taken down. Another community member noted the seller account was brand new.
quote: There was 4 posted for sale on eBay this morning, had consecutive numbers. Two were taken down

claim: A community member said a seller sold two numbered smileys at $300 each after a restock wave that suddenly showed four (two pink, two orange) with consecutive numbers.
quote: He sold 2 at $300… there suddenly were 4, two pink and two orange… consecutive numbers

claim: Community confirmation that regular mini prints are always 2.5x3.5 inches (standard art trading-card size) and fit standard sleeves/binders including Vault X binders.
quote: The regular mini prints are always 2.5x3.5. It’s the standard art trading card size.

claim: A community member said they are about to start an Excel-style list of all print variants; another said they were not aware of any existing list.
